provider_instruction_semantics.D_i: computational instructions required by provider i to execute one service invocation
provider_instruction_semantics.Dbar: central mean provider service-instruction requirement per invocation
provider_instruction_semantics.delta: provider-to-provider heterogeneity in mean service-instruction requirement
provider_instruction_semantics.root_workload_W: separate fixed invocation timing/pattern specified by period/rate and phase

sigma_semantics_audit.primary_definition: P(no violation of A occurs at any time t <= H)
sigma_semantics_audit.event_driven_equivalent: P(T_violation,A > H), where T_violation,A is the first actual violation event time

sampling_policy.discovery_target_0_95_rule: use empirical 0.9/1.0 bracket and curve/cause diagnostics; do not claim precision

development_atlas.lesson: 420M delta0 produced an informative latency case; coarse-atlas cost/mixed proposals had only two failures and were rejected as too sparse

finalist_quality_gate.latency_role: at least 3 latency-first and >=2:1 latency dominance over cost
finalist_quality_gate.cost_role: at least 3 cost-first and >=2:1 cost dominance over latency
finalist_quality_gate.mixed_role: at least 2 latency-first and 2 cost-first with imbalance <=2
